LetterNote.description:
The margin note a letter expands, as the caller stored it.

Attributes:
    kind: The note's kind, as a short lowercase token. Deliberately not
        :class:`NoteKind`: the caller's own note vocabulary may differ from
        the reflect tool's, and the field is a label for the prompt, not a
        classification Creek relies on. The pattern keeps it a token and
        never a second channel of prose.
    anchor_text: The passage of the entry the note is anchored to.
    note: The margin note itself.

WireTierCeiling.description:
The only two tier ceilings expressible on ``/v1``.

``/v1`` is remote by construction, and
:func:`creek_mcp.policy.admitted_ceiling` refuses any remote call declaring
a ceiling outside :data:`creek_mcp.policy.REMOTE_ADMITTED_CEILINGS` *before
dispatch*. Since #1073 that decision is transport-neutral, so every adapter
is meant to reach it the same way; the MCP surface does so today through
:meth:`creek_mcp.server._BoundedFastMCP.call_tool`, and #1074 mounts the
``/v1`` handlers that will. This enum mirrors that frozenset, so
``intimate`` and ``all`` are not merely refused at runtime — they cannot be
constructed at all, which is the half of the guarantee that does not depend
on a handler remembering to ask.

The same two values double as the wire's *tier* vocabulary (see
:class:`JournalUpsertRequest`, :class:`JournalUpsertResponse` and
:class:`ReflectionResponse`). The two vocabularies coincide by
construction: the set of tiers a remote caller may name is exactly the set
of ceilings a remote caller may declare, because a tier above the remote
cap is one no remote request can reach in either direction.

Attributes:
    OPEN: Openly publishable content only (ontology §13.2).
    PERSONAL: Adds personal — and, per #961, ``unclassified`` — content.
WireTierCeiling.title: WireTierCeiling

description:
Expand one margin note into its letter, stored under the path's id.

The caller's own text: no vault tier applies to it, so the declared
``tier`` is both the write tier of the stored Voice Draft and the content
tier routing reconciles with the ceiling.

Attributes:
    content: The full journal entry the note belongs to.
    note: The margin note being expanded.
    tier: The source entry's tier. ``intimate`` is unrepresentable on the
        remote wire, so an intimate entry cannot ask for a letter at all.
    title: Optional operator-safe title; omission uses the Voice Draft
        store's content-free placeholder.

content.description: The full entry; must not be blank.
content.title: Content

tier.description: Tier inherited from the source entry.

title.description: Optional title; omission uses a content-free placeholder.
title.title: Title
